What the AI Advisor does not do
  • Build, write, or design AI tools - that is Adam's job
  • Promise that anything will be built or give timelines
  • Replace Adam's judgment on what gets built, in what order, or how
  • Draft customer emails or do support troubleshooting (that's STA Support Chat)
  • Help with Salesforce admin questions (that's STA Salesforce Cohort)
  • Access live systems, files, or real-time data

STA Support Chat
Shared support-team Claude.ai Project grounded in the STA Help Center across all product lines. Diagnoses product issues, walks through troubleshooting steps, drafts customer-facing replies, and answers product mechanics questions. Hard rule: NEVER FABRICATE - flags what it doesn't know rather than guessing. Source-label taxonomy on every answer (confirmed / inferred / unknown).

Troubleshooting

Customer email draft
"Draft a calm reply to this customer email about sync delays [paste]. They're frustrated; we're still diagnosing. Keep it under 5 sentences."
Product mechanics lookup
"How does Tardy Kiosk handle bell-schedule overrides on early dismissal days?"
Routing question

What STA Support Chat does not do
  • Make up answers when it doesn't have grounding - it will say "I can't confirm this without checking [source]" instead
  • Replace your judgment on what to send a customer - drafts are starting points, not final replies
  • Access the live Salesforce case record or Help Center system directly - it works from the indexed context
  • Handle Salesforce admin / Flow questions (route those to STA Salesforce Cohort)

Data Rules - What Can and Cannot Go Into AI Tools
These rules are not optional. AI tools at School Tech are connected to Anthropic's Claude system. Treat them like a knowledgeable colleague - you wouldn't paste confidential data into a text message; apply the same standard here. The Claude Teams subscription does not train models on our conversations, but data still leaves School Tech's network in transit. Full rules in the AI Acceptable Use Policy and Restricted Data Reference Guide.
🚫
Student data - never
Student names, IDs, photos, attendance records, grades, or any data that came from a Skyward student record must NEVER be pasted into an AI tool. This includes support cases that contain student information - describe the issue in general terms without including the student-level data itself. If a case requires student data to resolve, handle it outside AI tools entirely.
🚫
Employee PII - never
School Tech staff Social Security numbers, payroll data, HR records, performance reviews, or personal identifiers (other than name and title) should not go into AI tools. Support cases about HR data from Skyward (payroll, employee records) fall under the same rule - describe the issue without including the actual record content.
⚠️
Customer confidential data - use judgment
Customer contact info (name, email, phone) and general case details are acceptable to use in AI tools for drafting and documentation. Do not paste full database exports, financial records, or anything a district would consider confidential internal data. When in doubt, describe the issue in general terms rather than pasting raw data.
✅
What's safe to use
Product names, configuration settings, error messages, general case descriptions, customer company names, email drafts (describing an issue, not containing student data), meeting notes from implementation calls (without including student or employee data), internal process documents, and questions about how School Tech tools or products work. If it's the kind of thing you'd write on a whiteboard in a meeting, it's generally fine.
Full policy: Read the AI Acceptable Use Policy (Training - Staff folder) for the complete rules. Read the Restricted Data Reference Guide for a full list of data categories that cannot go into AI tools.
Where to Go For What - Quick Routing Guide

Use this table when you're not sure which tool or person to go to.

SituationWhere to GoWhat to Bring
I don't know which AI tool to use AI Advisor Just describe the task you're trying to do
An AI tool gave me a wrong or strange answer Tell Adam - or log it with the Agent Quality Logger if you have Cowork access Screenshot of what the tool said, what you expected instead, which tool
I need to troubleshoot a product issue (TT clocks, SchoolTRAK, Tardy Kiosk, Food Service, etc.) STA Support Chat The product, the specific symptom, when it started, what's already been tried
I need to draft a customer email about a product issue STA Support Chat The customer email thread, the tone you want, what you need them to do next
I have a Salesforce admin question - field, formula, validation rule, layout STA Salesforce Cohort What you're trying to configure, what the goal is, what you've already tried
I need to build a heavy Salesforce Flow Open STA Salesforce Cohort first - it'll route you back to Adam What the flow should do, what triggers it, what records it touches
I have a question about how one of our products works (mechanics, configuration, compatibility) STA Support Chat for product mechanics; AI Advisor for general "what is X" Product name, the specific question, what context the question is for
I'd like to explore whether AI could help with one of my workflows AI Advisor The actual workflow, step by step, including frequency and any pain points
I want to build a new AI project or tool Adam - he runs the build pipeline through The Architect Describe what you'd like the tool to do and who would use it
I think something sensitive was accidentally pasted into an AI tool Adam immediately What was shared, which tool, when
